topic: Jose Delgado (1955, 1964) Wireless Stimoceiver Bull Stop in Cordoba, Caudate Nucleus (Basal Ganglia) Forced Motor Turning vs Mind-Control Myth, and Evolution into Modern Deep Brain Stimulation (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: The transformation of Delgado's 1955-1964 wireless basal-ganglia stimoceiver into modern FDA-approved Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) and closed-loop neuro-pacemakers restoring movement to over 250,000 Parkinson's and epilepsy patients.
